title: Tutorial Quest: Ammo Delivery
description: Learn the basics of in-game quests! Deliver 5k ammo to the next startbase and earn your first token rewards. A Maxhog is available in the Armory to help you transport the ammo (collateral: 0.025 SOL).
goal: Deliver 5,000 ammo units to the next startbase using the provided Maxhog
requirements: Claim quest resources from Armory (5K ammo + QuestMaxhog token)
Use Maxhog from Armory (collateral: 1 QuestMaxhog token)
Return Maxhog to Armory after delivery
creator: guild1_founder
